# Intake brief — RELEASE.md deploy-workflow description is stale (CG-0MUIGWT96001UEY7)

## Objective

Reconcile the deploy-workflow description in `RELEASE.md` with the workflow that
actually runs (`.github/workflows/deploy.yml`: sibling composition + build +
Pages deploy, no tests), and add a regression test that keeps the document in
sync with the workflow so it cannot silently drift again.

## Problem statement

`RELEASE.md` still documents the deploy workflow as installing Playwright
Chromium, running a Monte Carlo harness job, and running `npm test` (unit +
browser) before the build. None of those steps have existed in
`.github/workflows/deploy.yml` since commit `1a45e1a5` ("Remove Monte Carlo job
from deploy workflow") and the build-only CI decision (`CG-0MT022826006EM0D`).
`CG-0MUGSGH7Q002NOA1` only corrected the build-step line (its AC4); the broader
staleness was deliberately left out of scope. The result is that the project's
release document misrepresents the CI gate and sends contributors to commands
CI never runs.

## Users

- **TCE maintainers / contributors** following `RELEASE.md` before a release.
- **Release & CI operators** checking what the deploy workflow actually does.

Example user stories:

- As a TCE maintainer, I want `RELEASE.md` to state exactly what
  `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` runs, so I can trust the release documentation.
- As a contributor, I want the "reproduce CI locally" instructions to be
  accurate, so I do not waste time on steps the workflow never performs.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC1:** `RELEASE.md`'s "Quick summary" and "What the release workflow does"
  describe the deploy workflow accurately: it builds (and only builds) the full
  distribution and deploys to Pages; the step list matches `deploy.yml` exactly
  (Checkout → Setup Node.js → Install dependencies → Compose sibling game
  repositories → Build with `GAMES_CONFIG=full npm run build` → Configure Pages
  → Upload artifact → Deploy to GitHub Pages). No section of `RELEASE.md` claims
  a Playwright Chromium install, a Monte Carlo job, or an `npm test` step as
  part of the deploy workflow.
- **AC2:** The "Important notes about CI and tests" section states that CI is
  build-only — `deploy.yml` and `pr-checks.yml` run `npm run build`; tests are
  run locally (`npm test` full suite before release; unit tests minimum during
  development) — and removes the "main branch CI runs a stricter set of Monte
  Carlo checks" claim.
- **AC3:** The "Reproduce main CI tests" / "Manual commands" sections are
  corrected: CI-parity reproduction is `GAMES_CONFIG=full npm run build`, and
  `npm run monte-carlo` is presented as a **local-only** balance tool (requires
  the `../tce-main-street` sibling) that is **not** run by CI. The Monte Carlo
  line in the "Pre-release checklist" is corrected the same way.
- **AC4:** A regression test pins `RELEASE.md`'s deploy-workflow description to
  `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` — asserting the documented step set matches the
  workflow's step names and that removed steps (Playwright install, Monte Carlo
  job, `npm test`) are not claimed — so either side drifting fails the test.
- **AC5:** All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes,
  including code comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries.
- **AC6:** Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.

## Constraints

- Documentation + test only: **no workflow behaviour change** and no edits to
  `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`.
- Do **not** touch the "Windows binary (Steam artifact)" or "Steam build"
  sections of `RELEASE.md`: the Windows/Steam narrative is owned by the blocked
  doc item `CG-0MUOAXTMG004FGPY` (automatic release promotion) and its sibling
  CI items. Keep this change confined to the deploy-workflow / CI-and-tests
  content.
- Keep `RELEASE.md` as the canonical release document — it is referenced from
  `README.md` and `docs/DEVELOPER.md` (line 229), so do not relocate content
  without updating those pointers.
- Follow the project doc-update policy (docs updated in the same commit as the
  workflow/CI description they describe).

## Existing state

- `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` — build-only: Checkout → Setup Node.js →
  `npm ci` → Compose sibling game repositories → `GAMES_CONFIG=full npm run
  build` → Configure Pages → Upload artifact → Deploy to GitHub Pages. No test,
  Playwright, or Monte Carlo step.
- `.github/workflows/pr-checks.yml` — build-only (`npm run build`).
- `.github/workflows/package.yml` — Windows binary packaging (separate; out of
  scope, correctly described elsewhere in `RELEASE.md`).
- `RELEASE.md` stale content: steps 3–5 (lines ~18–20), "Important notes about
  CI and tests" (lines ~28–34), "Pre-release checklist" Monte Carlo line
  (lines ~63–65), "Reproduce main CI tests" (lines ~73–76), and the Monte Carlo
  artifacts bullet under "Where the workflow lives" (line ~92). The "Quick
  summary" bullet claiming the workflow runs tests is also stale.
- Decided: CI is build-only per `CG-0MT022826006EM0D`; the Monte Carlo job was
  removed by `1a45e1a5`.
- Precedent for a workflow-contract test: `tests/scripts/deploy-workflow.test.ts`
  (`CG-0MUGSGH7Q002NOA1`), which parses workflow steps and pins the preset wiring.

## Desired change

1. Correct the stale deploy-workflow / CI / test descriptions in `RELEASE.md`
   so they match the live workflows (deploy = build + deploy only; tests local;
   Monte Carlo local-only).
2. Add (or extend) a regression test that pins the `RELEASE.md` deploy-workflow
   description to `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`, mirroring the existing
   `deploy-workflow.test.ts` contract-test approach.

## Key Files (predicted)

- `RELEASE.md` — correct the stale deploy-workflow, CI-and-tests, checklist, and
  manual-command sections.
- `tests/scripts/deploy-workflow.test.ts` — extend, or add a sibling
  `tests/scripts/release-doc-consistency.test.ts` — pin the doc ↔ workflow
  consistency.
- `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` — read-only source of truth (not modified).
- `docs/DEVELOPER.md` — verify the `RELEASE.md` pointer (line 229) stays
  accurate.
- `README.md` — verify the `RELEASE.md` pointer (line 68) stays accurate.

## Related work

- **CG-0MUGSGH7Q002NOA1** (discovered-from) — added the sibling-composition
  step and `GAMES_CONFIG=full` Build step; corrected only the build line.
- **CG-0MT022826006EM0D** — build-only CI decision (PR CI = build only).
- Commit `1a45e1a5` — removed the Monte Carlo job from `deploy.yml`.
- **CG-0MUOAXTMG004FGPY** (blocked) — doc update for automatic Windows release
  promotion, touching `RELEASE.md`'s Windows binary section; avoid overlap.
- **CG-0MULGC6VP008GPH2** — `package.yml` sibling composition / core-only build.
- `docs/DEVELOPER.md` — release/deployment section; `AGENTS.md` — CI/test
  guidance.

## Risks & assumptions

- **Risk — conflict with `CG-0MUOAXTMG004FGPY`:** both items edit `RELEASE.md`.
  Mitigation: confine this item to deploy-workflow/CI-and-tests content; leave
  the Windows/Steam sections untouched.
- **Risk — scope creep into the release narrative:** the "Quick summary" also
  frames releases as automatic on push to `main`, while the canonical promotion
  path is the `ship` skill (dev → main). Mitigation: correct only the
  deploy-workflow facts this item names; record any release-narrative
  restructuring as a separate work item rather than expanding scope.
- **Risk — brittle doc test:** parsing Markdown too strictly makes the test
  fragile. Mitigation: assert on stable step-name substrings and the absence of
  removed steps, mirroring `deploy-workflow.test.ts`.
- **Assumption:** CI parity for tests is "run locally"; deploy/PR CI has no test
  step by design (`CG-0MT022826006EM0D`).
- **Assumption:** `npm run monte-carlo` remains a valid local tool (package.json
  retains the script) and should stay documented as local-only, not removed.

## Appendix: Clarifying questions & answers

No producer questions were required — the seed context (the item description,
`CG-0MUGSGH7Q002NOA1`, `CG-0MT022826006EM0D`, commit `1a45e1a5`, and the live
`deploy.yml`) is sufficient to draft a clear, testable brief. The following
decisions were treated as agent assumptions and are recorded for the producer's
review; they are low-risk and reversible during implementation.

- Q: Which sections of `RELEASE.md` are in scope? — Answer (agent assumption,
  no producer input): all deploy-workflow-related staleness plus adjacent
  CI/test claims (steps, "Important notes about CI and tests", pre-release
  checklist Monte Carlo line, "Reproduce main CI tests", Monte Carlo artifacts
  bullet). The Windows/Steam sections are excluded to avoid overlap with
  `CG-0MUOAXTMG004FGPY`.
- Q: Should Monte Carlo be removed from `RELEASE.md` entirely? — Answer (agent
  assumption): no — keep it as a documented **local-only** balance tool (the
  `npm run monte-carlo` script still exists), but stop attributing it to CI.
- Q: Should the release-process narrative (dev → main via the `ship` skill) also
  be rewritten? — Answer (agent assumption): no — out of scope for this item;
  record as a separate work item if needed.

## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items
- **CG-0MULGC6VP008GPH2** – CI Windows binary ships no games: package.yml builds core-only while launch smoke asserts ≥9 (open)
- **CG-0MLSHQJIU0097VRY** – Add README and Developer Docs (completed)
- **CG-0MTCOPO8U001UW2Y** – Review all tests (completed)

### Repository file matches
- `docs/DEVELOPER.md` — matched: 0mt022826006em0d, ac4, artifact, browser, build (+58 more)
- `AGENTS.md` — matched: 0mt022826006em0d, artifact, browser, build, carlo (+43 more)
- `RELEASE.md` — matched: artifact, browser, build, carlo, checkout (+35 more)
